text:
maria: FYI — during the 03:10 UTC prune wave argocd skipped ~120 child apps in app-of-apps /shard-5. UI shows "prune skipped (lock active)" and we have token-rotation errors in the controller logs. looks like leader rebalance + token refresh coincided with the prune window. :disappointed_relieved:

sanjay: Ugh. Did we get a deploy-bot event around that time? wondering if rolling restarts triggered leader elections.

deploy-bot: deploy event: argocd-controller v1.11.2 -> v1.11.3 started at 03:06 UTC (canary roll).

lee: Confirmed, I saw multiple controller pods restart during the canary. Leader switched twice within 2m which probably caused lock churn.

maria: Pasted the relevant log snippet from controller-2 (03:09:55 -> 03:11:10):

```
I0312 03:09:56.123 controller.go:423] starting prune wave batch=50
W0312 03:09:57.456 lock.go:87] failed to acquire lock key=prune/shard-5: ttl expired while leader election in progress
E0312 03:10:12.789 token_refresher.go:142] token refresh failed: 401 unauthorized: public-key-rotation
W0312 03:10:34.001 controller.go:439] prune skipped due to active lock for 120 apps
```

anna: That 401 during token refresh stands out. Our vault KMS rotated signing key at 03:08 and there was a short window where the controller couldn't validate the token. Combined with leader churn, lock acquisition failed.

sanjay: Two quick mitigation ideas: 1) widen prune window or stagger prune by shards to avoid leader handoff windows; 2) increase lock TTL and retry backoff so transient token refreshes don't abort the batch. Thoughts?

lee: +1 on TTL bump. Also reduce batch size for shard-5 to 20 while we tweak rotation timing. Smaller batch → less chance of long-running exclusive lock.

maria: Action plan:
- increase argocd prune lock TTL from 30s -> 90s (temporary)
- set shard-5 prune.batch_size = 20 for next two prune cycles
- ask security to align KMS rotation with non-critical windows (avoid on-prune times)
- add metric/alert for "prune skipped due to lock" spikes

kubeops-bot: runbook note created: KB-1423 "prune-lock-contention". link: https://wiki.redwood/KB-1423

anna: I'll file a KMS rotation schedule ticket and cc infra. Also let's add a canary gate so controller rollouts avoid simultaneous restarts across all replicas.

maria: I'll apply TTL and batch-size override now (one-line tf apply). Patching terraform var: `argocd.prune_lock_ttl_seconds = 90` and `argocd.shards.shard-5.prune_batch = 20`. Will monitor next prune at 03:40. :eyes:

sanjay: If prune still skips, we should consider moving prune to leaderless mode (optimistic prune) for app-of-apps, but that's riskier. Keep us posted.

lee: Monitoring: added Grafana panel for prune.skip_rate and a datadog alert at >10 skips/5m.

maria: Patch applied. terraform plan/app logs:
```
Apply complete! Resources changed: 2
Outputs: none
```

maria: Next prune at 03:40 completed successfully for shard-5 with no skips (applied overrides held). Will follow up after next 24h window. :white_check_mark:
